category: 能量和能源的使用/Energy and Use of Energy
questionText:
一盞 $12\ \text{W}$ 燈的發光效能為 $90\ \text{lm W}^{-1}$。它發出的可見光中，每 $1\ \text{W}$ 光功率相當於 $500\ \text{lm}$ 的光通量。這盞燈把電能轉換為光能的效率是多少？
A $12\ \text{W}$ lamp has a luminous efficacy of $90\ \text{lm W}^{-1}$. For the visible light it emits, $1\ \text{W}$ of light power corresponds to a luminous flux of $500\ \text{lm}$. What is the efficiency of the lamp in converting electrical energy into light energy?

category: 能量和能源的使用/Energy and Use of Energy
questionText:
以下哪些有關風力渦輪機的描述正確？
(1) 若風速加倍，可用的風功率增加至 8 倍。
(2) 若葉片長度加倍，可用的風功率增加至 4 倍。
(3) 可用的風功率與空氣密度的二次方成正比。
Which of the following statements about wind turbines is/are correct?
(1) If the wind speed is doubled, the available wind power becomes 8 times as large.
(2) If the blade length is doubled, the available wind power becomes 4 times as large.
(3) The available wind power is proportional to the square of the air density.

category: 能量和能源的使用/Energy and Use of Energy
questionText:
在某時刻，到達地面的太陽輻射強度為 $800\ \text{W m}^{-2}$，陽光與一塊太陽能板的法線成 $30^{\circ}$。太陽能板的面積為 $2.5\ \text{m}^{2}$，效率為 $18\%$。太陽能板的電功率輸出是多少？
At a certain moment, the intensity of solar radiation reaching the ground is $800\ \text{W m}^{-2}$, and the sunlight makes $30^{\circ}$ with the normal to a solar panel. The panel has an area of $2.5\ \text{m}^{2}$ and an efficiency of $18\%$. What is the electrical power output of the panel?

category: 能量和能源的使用/Energy and Use of Energy
questionText:
一幢長方體辦公大樓長 $30\ \text{m}$、闊 $20\ \text{m}$、高 $15\ \text{m}$（見下圖）。四面外牆共有 $40$ 扇相同的窗，每扇 $2.5\ \text{m}\times1.5\ \text{m}$。經實心外牆及經窗傳入大樓的熱量（包括傳導及太陽輻射）分別平均為每平方米 $15\ \text{W}$ 和 $120\ \text{W}$。這幢大樓外牆的總熱傳送值（OTTV）是多少？
A rectangular office block is $30\ \text{m}$ long, $20\ \text{m}$ wide and $15\ \text{m}$ high (see the figure). Its four external walls have a total of $40$ identical windows, each $2.5\ \text{m}\times1.5\ \text{m}$. The average heat transferred into the building (conduction and solar radiation) through the opaque walls and through the windows is $15\ \text{W}$ and $120\ \text{W}$ per square metre respectively. What is the overall thermal transfer value (OTTV) of the external walls of the building?

category: 能量和能源的使用/Energy and Use of Energy
questionText:
以下哪些有關窗的 U 值的描述正確？
(1) 雙層玻璃窗的 U 值比單層玻璃窗小，因為兩層玻璃之間的空氣層熱導率很低。
(2) 窗的面積越大，它的 U 值越大。
(3) 在相同的溫差下，每單位面積經窗傳送熱量的速率與窗的 U 值成正比。
Which of the following statements about the U-value of a window is/are correct?
(1) A double-glazed window has a smaller U-value than a single-glazed window because the air layer between the panes has a very low thermal conductivity.
(2) The larger the area of a window, the larger its U-value.
(3) For the same temperature difference, the rate of heat transfer per unit area through a window is proportional to its U-value.

category: 能量和能源的使用/Energy and Use of Energy
questionText:
下圖顯示一部冷氣機能源標籤上的部分資料（示意）。一個家庭每年使用這部冷氣機 $150$ 日，每日運作 $6$ 小時。假設冷氣機運作時的製冷量及性能系數與標籤所示相同，估算它每年消耗的電能。
The figure shows part of the information on the energy label of an air conditioner (for illustration). A family uses it for $150$ days a year, $6$ hours a day. Assuming the cooling capacity and coefficient of performance during operation are as shown on the label, estimate the electrical energy it consumes per year.

category: 能量和能源的使用/Energy and Use of Energy
questionText:
下圖顯示一個水力發電站。水塘水面與渦輪機出水口的高度差 $h$ 為 $45\ \text{m}$。以下哪些正確？
(1) 若水下降 $h$ 時減少的重力勢能全部轉為動能，水的速率約為 $30\ \text{m s}^{-1}$。
(2) 若體積流率為 $20\ \text{m}^{3}\ \text{s}^{-1}$，總效率為 $80\%$，輸出電功率約為 $7.1\ \text{MW}$。
(3) 在 $h$ 及體積流率不變下，把水管改窄，水流得較快，所以輸出功率會增加。
The figure shows a hydroelectric power station. The height difference $h$ between the reservoir surface and the turbine outlet is $45\ \text{m}$. Which of the following is/are correct?
(1) If all the gravitational potential energy lost by the water in falling through $h$ became kinetic energy, the speed of the water would be about $30\ \text{m s}^{-1}$.
(2) If the volume flow rate is $20\ \text{m}^{3}\ \text{s}^{-1}$ and the overall efficiency is $80\%$, the electrical output power is about $7.1\ \text{MW}$.
(3) With $h$ and the volume flow rate unchanged, making the pipe narrower makes the water flow faster, so the output power increases.

category: 能量和能源的使用/Energy and Use of Energy
questionText:
一座核電站以鈽-239 為燃料，電功率輸出為 $900\ \text{MW}$，整體效率為 $33\%$。每個鈽-239 核裂變時的質量虧損為 $0.215\ \text{u}$，鈽-239 的摩爾質量為 $0.239\ \text{kg mol}^{-1}$。估算核電站每日消耗的鈽-239 質量。
A nuclear power station uses plutonium-239 as fuel. Its electrical power output is $900\ \text{MW}$ and its overall efficiency is $33\%$. The mass defect in each fission of plutonium-239 is $0.215\ \text{u}$, and the molar mass of plutonium-239 is $0.239\ \text{kg mol}^{-1}$. Estimate the mass of plutonium-239 used by the power station each day.
